text:
lena (AE): Heads-up: Aurora Pulse sent an RFI focused on pilot ops, pricing bands for reserved capacity, and a short security checklist. Can we gather answers?
mike (SE): I can take POC runbook and perf targets. They listed 180 qps gen + 400 rpm embeddings. Recommend 10 business day pilot with clear acceptance criteria.
paul (Solutions Eng): For sustained 180 qps I'd recommend Dedicated with 1.5x buffer. Quick pricing ballpark: $16k-26k/month depending on region and term. Offer 15% pilot discount.
lena (AE): They also want to know if we can limit data residency to EU for the pilot and provide audit exports.
sylvia (Security): We can host their pilot in our EU region and provide structured audit logs (S3 export or API). Copyable snippet for RFI: 
"Redwood can restrict pilot workloads to the EU region; structured audit logs (including model deployment events and admin actions) are available for export via S3 or our audit API."
mike (SE): Add a note about key management: BYOK supported on Private via KMIP and on Dedicated with customer-managed Cloud KMS. Hosted envelope scenarios available.
paul (Solutions Eng): Draft capability matrix rows:
- Data Residency: "EU-only pilot available; Private/on-prem for stricter controls"
- KMS/HSM: "BYOK: KMIP HSM or Cloud KMS; key usage audit events"
- Observability: "Per-route latency, token counts, exportable CSVs"
lena (AE): Perfect. Contracts Q: they asked for an overage rate during pilot and a refundable trial deposit. Any precedent?
paul (Solutions Eng): Recommend overage: $0.13 per gen-token-equivalent and $0.0012 per embed. Deposit: one-month reserved fee held and refunded upon completion if terms met.
sylvia (Security): For compliance add: "SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 reports available under NDA; annual third-party pentests." Also note we cannot assert FedRAMP.
mike (SE): Preflight checklist for their infra team:
- Allow outbound 443 to region-specific endpoints
- Provide static egress IPs if they want firewall whitelisting
- Test: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/health
- Verify TLS: openssl s_client -connect eu.api.redwood.ai:443 -brief
lena (AE): Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/aurora-pulse-rfi/ (capmatrix + SOW draft). I'll add the commercial sheet.
contracts-bot: Reminder: attach standard DPA and SOW template to Drive folder.
lena (AE): Action items: mike = runbook + preflight; paul = pricing bands + capmatrix updates; sylvia = security copy + audit text. Ill assemble final RFI and loop in Legal. Thanks! :thumbsup:
